articles.title: India's Rally Defies Global Rout, but Analysts Warn the Rotation Can Reverse
articles.excerpt: Benchmarks are up about 10.5 per cent in seven sessions while the S&P 500 posted its worst week since April 2025. Strategists call it a rotation out of AI stocks, not a decoupling — and say it holds only while the selling stays in technology.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora investors holding both US tech and Indian equities, India's low AI-hardware weight is currently acting as the portfolio hedge — with named conditions that would end it.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items.label: Potential Net Inflows if Positions Neutralized

articles.title: MakeMyTrip's India Arm Wins Sebi Nod for IPO Built as Share Sale by Parent
articles.excerpt: Sebi issued final observations on November 6 on the confidential July filing. The offer is a sale of MMT India shares by MakeMyTrip and ibibo Group Holdings, and the India unit stays a subsidiary after listing.
articles.nri_angle: A Nasdaq-listed Indian travel group is bringing its India unit to Indian exchanges — relevant to NRI investors who book on the platform and follow Indian listings.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Gold Rebounds Above $4,100 Despite Strong US Payrolls, Ahead of Inflation Test
articles.excerpt: Spot gold traded at $4,121.77 on Monday after Friday's 165,000-job payrolls surprise knocked it toward $4,033 — Tuesday's US CPI print now decides whether the rebound holds, with December hike odds near 80%.
articles.image_caption: Gold crystals are shown in close-up. Spot gold reclaimed $4,100 on Monday after a stronger than expected US payrolls report knocked it toward $4,033 on Friday.
articles.nri_angle: For Indian households and NRI investors who bought gold through the festival season, the level to watch is $4,100: holding it into Tuesday's CPI keeps the festival-season rebound intact, losing it reopens the $4,000 test.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Dalal Street Week Ahead: Inflation, Earnings and Foreign Flows Decide the Rally
articles.excerpt: After the Nifty reclaimed 25,000 on a Rs 45,960 crore foreign buying week, a holiday-shortened week brings India and US inflation prints, continuing Q2 earnings and a test of whether foreign flows hold.
articles.nri_angle: For NRI investors in Indian equities, the week tests whether the foreign inflow that powered the Diwali rally is a durable return or a one-week reversal.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: AI Selloff Is a Speed Adjustment, Not a Bust, iM Securities Says
articles.excerpt: Semiconductor stocks fell 11.4% in the days around the US midterms while hyperscaler shares rose, a split iM Securities says points to slower AI spending growth, not an end to the investment cycle.
articles.image_caption: The Korea Exchange in Busan is pictured in a Wikimedia Commons photograph. A Seoul-based iM Securities strategist called the global AI selloff a speed adjustment rather than a bust.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora investors holding US chip and AI names, the split between falling semiconductor shares and steady hyperscalers is the signal to watch before treating the selloff as a cycle end.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: AI Slump Revives Asia's Forgotten Trades as Investors Turn to China and India
articles.excerpt: Bloomberg reports a broadening rotation out of crowded AI supply-chain stocks: the Nifty 50 just had its best week since 2021 on $1.9 billion of foreign buying, and a Hong Kong gauge of mainland shares its best week since March 2025.
articles.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange in Mumbai. India's Nifty 50 gained 8.6 percent last week as foreign funds returned to local shares.
articles.nri_angle: For NRI investors concentrated in US AI names, the rotation is a live diversification question: India and China are drawing the flows their portfolios may be missing.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Sensex, Nifty End Muhurat Trading Lower for First Time in Nine Years
articles.excerpt: The Sensex slipped 28.62 points and the Nifty fell back below 25,000 in Sunday's Diwali session, snapping a seven-day rally as Samvat 2083 began — though smaller stocks rose and investor wealth still grew by Rs 2.60 lakh crore.
articles.nri_angle: Indian markets opened Samvat 2083 on a flat note after a record pre-Diwali run, a session NRI investors watch as the traditional start of the Hindu financial year.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Adani Enterprises Plans Rs 35,000-40,000 Crore Annual Capex Over Next Two Years
articles.excerpt: Airports, data centres and the Mundra PVC complex will lead Adani Enterprises' Rs 35,000-40,000 crore annual capex, after record first-half EBITDA of Rs 11,958 crore.
articles.image_caption: Adani Enterprises
articles.nri_angle: Adani Enterprises' capex guidance matters to investors tracking whether airports, data centres and PVC convert heavy spending into earnings.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Nilesh Shah Bets on Earnings Recovery in Samvat 2083, Picks Three Sectors
articles.excerpt: Kotak Mahindra AMC's managing director expects FY27 earnings growth of 12-15% for large-caps and flags banking, premium consumption and modern manufacturing as the Samvat 2083 opportunities.
articles.image_caption: Nilesh Shah of Kotak Mahindra AMC in a file photograph. Shah expects an earnings recovery in Samvat 2083 and favours banking and financial services, premium consumption and modern manufacturing shares.
articles.nri_angle: For NRI investors allocating to India this Diwali, Shah's message is to expect earnings-led, high-single to low-double-digit compounding rather than a rerating boom.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: VIX Jumped 11.57 Points in a Day; History Says Six Months Later Stocks Were Usually Higher
articles.excerpt: The fear gauge closed at 28.18 on November 5 as the S&P 500 fell 4.41% and the Nasdaq 100 dropped 6.5%. In Bespoke's 19 similar spikes since 1990, the S&P 500's median return six months later was 4.8%, positive 79% of the time — with a negative average over the first month.
articles.nri_angle: Many diaspora investors hold US index and semiconductor exposure through 401(k)s and brokerages; the Bespoke table gives them the sourced historical odds, and the limits of those odds, after the year's sharpest fear spike.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Coca-Cola's India Bottler Files IPO in Pure Shareholder Sell-Down
articles.excerpt: Hindustan Coca-Cola Holdings' draft prospectus offers up to 997.5 million existing shares; its majority owner cuts its stake to about 45% and the company gets no fresh funds.
articles.image_caption: The Coca-Cola Tower, part of the Coca-Cola Company's headquarters complex (file photo). Hindustan Coca-Cola Holdings, the brand's largest bottler in India, has filed draft IPO papers with SEBI.
articles.nri_angle: For NRI investors who track Indian consumer listings, this is a large, familiar-brand offer to watch — but it is a parent sell-down, not a growth fundraise, and no price band exists yet.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Tata Steel Q2 Profit Rises 16% to Rs 3,700 Crore on India Strength
articles.excerpt: Consolidated reported profit after tax rose 16.2% to Rs 3,699.59 crore in the September quarter as revenue from operations climbed 11.5% to Rs 65,436.24 crore and EBITDA reached Rs 10,665 crore.
articles.image_caption: A Tata Steel plant is seen with the company name on a storage tank. Tata Steel reported second-quarter results on November 7, 2026.
articles.nri_angle: Tata Steel's India-led earnings and Rs 91,423 crore net debt position matter for diaspora investors holding Indian steel and infrastructure exposure.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Berkshire Operating Earnings Fall 5.8% as Buybacks Hit $9.6 Billion
articles.excerpt: Third-quarter operating earnings slipped to $12.705 billion on weaker insurance results, while Berkshire more than doubled buybacks to $9.6 billion and its shares rose more than 5% in a week when the S&P 500 fell almost 2.7%.
articles.image_caption: A display shows Berkshire Hathaway Inc. listed on the New York Stock Exchange. Berkshire reported third-quarter operating earnings and a $9.6 billion share buyback on Saturday.
articles.nri_angle: Berkshire's defensive earnings mix and record buybacks offer a contrast for diaspora investors concentrated in AI-heavy technology stocks.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Sensex's 10.6% Seven-Session Pre-Diwali Rally Is Its Strongest in 35 Years
articles.excerpt: The Sensex closed at 81,028 and the Nifty reclaimed 25,000 on Friday as foreign investors poured in about Rs 49,500 crore, crude slid and the market posted its best week since February 2021.
articles.image_caption: Sensex
articles.nri_angle: A record pre-Diwali rally matters directly to diaspora investors holding Indian equities and mutual funds.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Europe's Rearmament Turned Indian Shells Into a Rs 38,000 Crore Export Story
articles.excerpt: India's defence exports hit a record Rs 38,424 crore in FY2025-26, and Bloomberg's trade-data analysis shows at least $872 million of Indian shells, mortars and explosives shipped to Europe since 2022.
articles.image_caption: A 155mm howitzer shell (file photo). Indian firms have shipped artillery shells, mortar rounds and explosives to Europe in sharply higher volumes since 2022, trade data analysed by Bloomberg shows.
articles.nri_angle: India's emergence as a major ammunition supplier to Europe is a markets story for diaspora investors tracking Indian defence stocks.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Gold Has Risen Fivefold in a Decade; Motilal Oswal Sees Rs 1.68 Lakh Ahead
articles.excerpt: Motilal Oswal's quarterly bullion report expects domestic gold at Rs 1.60-1.68 lakh per 10 grams within 6 to 12 months, against about Rs 30,000 at Diwali 2016 and around Rs 1.5 lakh this Dhanteras.
articles.image_caption: Native gold crystals. Motilal Oswal expects domestic gold to reach Rs 1.60 lakh to Rs 1.68 lakh per 10 grams within 12 months.

sources.label: Tezzbuzz — Motilal Oswal precious metals targets

articles.nri_angle: Gold buying on Dhanteras is a fixed ritual for many diaspora families, whether in India or through jewellers abroad; a fivefold decade rise to about Rs 1.5 lakh per 10 grams, with a brokerage target of Rs 1.68 lakh, changes the size of that annual decision materially.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.image_caption: Nvidia

articles.title: Airbnb Earnings Beat Estimates as Revenue Rises 19% to $4.87 Billion in Q3 Results
articles.excerpt: Airbnb's Q3 diluted EPS of $3.16 topped the $2.85 consensus as revenue beat forecasts, gross booking value rose 21% to $27.7 billion, and the company raised its full-year growth outlook to the high teens.
articles.image_caption: Airbnb headquarters in San Francisco. The company beat third-quarter estimates as revenue rose 19% to $4.87 billion.

articles.title: Angel One Overtakes Zerodha as India's Second-Largest Broker as Groww Pulls Ahead

articles.image_caption: Zerodha
articles.nri_angle: For NRI investors holding demat accounts in India, the broker reshuffle is a practical prompt to compare platforms on NRI onboarding, charges and support, not just headline client rankings.

articles.title: CBI Books Kishore Biyani, Future Retail in Rs 904 Crore SBI Fraud Case
articles.excerpt: India's Central Bureau of Investigation registered the case on November 4 on a State Bank of India complaint and searched premises linked to Future Retail's promoters in Mumbai on Friday, alleging loan funds were diverted through associate companies.
articles.image_caption: Kishore Biyani is pictured alongside the Central Bureau of Investigation headquarters gate in an NDTV Profit graphic. The CBI has booked Biyani and Future Retail in an alleged Rs 904 crore State Bank of India loan fraud case.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora investors who tracked Future Retail and Big Bazaar as symbols of India's organised-retail boom, the CBI case is a major test of lender recovery and governance in a group already ordered into liquidation in 2024.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: ADNOC Signs 10-Year LNG Supply Deal With India's Gujarat Energy, From 2028
articles.excerpt: The agreement covers up to 4 million tonnes of LNG over a decade, is ADNOC's fifth LNG supply deal in India, and marks the first sale from XRG's international portfolio.
articles.image_caption: ADNOC Headquarters in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. ADNOC signed a 10-year LNG supply agreement with India's Gujarat Energy, with deliveries scheduled to begin in 2028.
articles.nri_angle: A long-term UAE–India energy contract that underpins gas supply to 44 districts across six Indian states served by Gujarat Energy's city gas network.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Rupee Closes at Six-Month High as Foreign Investors Return to Indian Equities
articles.excerpt: The rupee closed at 93.9050 per dollar, its strongest since April, after nearly $3 billion of foreign equity buying in a week — including $1.6 billion on Thursday alone.
articles.image_caption: Indian rupee notes and coins (file photo). The rupee closed at a six-month high as foreign investors returned to Indian equities.
articles.nri_angle: For anyone sending money to India, the recovery matters directly: a dollar bought 96.96 rupees at May's record low and buys about 93.9 now, so timing a transfer this month yields roughly 3% less than in May.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: PL Capital Names 10 Diwali Stock Picks for Samvat 2083, Heavy on Power Names
articles.excerpt: The brokerage's technical desk picks Apollo Hospitals, DLF and six power and electrical names, with target ranges implying 23% to 47% upside from Friday's closes.
articles.image_caption: Capital
articles.nri_angle: For NRI investors joining Muhurat trading on November 8, PL Capital's list offers ten researched starting points with explicit targets and stop losses — and a heavy tilt to India's power build-out.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Gold Returned 60% Last Diwali and 13% This One; Analysts Target $5,000 Next
articles.excerpt: Diwali-to-Diwali data show gold beating the Nifty five years running despite a record high and a sharp 2026 correction — and what brokerages expect for Samvat 2083.
articles.image_caption: Gold
articles.nri_angle: Dhanteras gold buying is a portfolio decision for diaspora families too: the data argue for staged accumulation near analyst accumulation zones rather than a single festival-day purchase at peak prices.

articles.title: Indian IT Stocks Shrug Off Wall Street Rout as Nifty IT Rises 2%
articles.excerpt: Infosys, TCS and Mphasis led Indian IT higher on Friday morning even after US stocks posted their worst day since April 2025 in an AI-led sell-off.
articles.nri_angle: Indian IT services firms, which earn most of their revenue from US clients, rose in Mumbai even as the US AI trade unwound, a divergence that matters to diaspora investors holding both markets.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Rebased Its GDP, but Rs 34.5 Lakh Crore of Women's Work Counts for Nothing
articles.excerpt: A ministry-backed study values women's unpaid domestic and care work at up to Rs 34.5 lakh crore — an estimated 15-17% of GDP depending on the wage used — yet the February 2026 rebasing still leaves it outside the accounts.

Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation

articles.nri_angle: The care-economy debate in India covers the ageing parents and children diaspora families support from abroad, and decides whether that unpaid work is ever counted or funded.

articles.excerpt: Airtel's Q2 FY27 net profit of Rs 8,888 crore beat last year but fell short of the Rs 9,673 crore analysts expected, as network costs rose 11% and licence fees 13%.

articles.title: India's 10-Year Yield Falls to 7.07% as Democrats' Sweep Cuts Oil and US Yields
articles.excerpt: Benchmark Indian bond yields dropped 12 basis points after the US midterm result, as falling crude, a stronger rupee and lower Treasury yields combined — and fund managers say the December RBI review is now the key test.
articles.image_caption: The National Stock Exchange building in Mumbai. India's 10-year government bond yield fell to 7.07 percent as a Democrats' sweep in the US midterms cut oil prices and US yields.
articles.nri_angle: For Indian and NRI bond investors, gilt and long-duration fund values have risen with the rally; the practical question is the December RBI review, not chasing duration now.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: SEBI Approves Mahanadi Coalfields IPO as Coal India Sells Ten Percent
articles.excerpt: SEBI has approved the IPO of Coal India's Odisha unit Mahanadi Coalfields, through which the parent will sell a 10 per cent stake, or up to 661.8 million shares.
articles.image_caption: SEBI
articles.nri_angle: A $1 billion-scale reported Indian IPO is directly relevant to diaspora investors who track Coal India and India's marquee listings, pending the final price band and subscription dates.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Sensex Surges 1,419 Points as Crude Crashes After US Midterm Sweep
articles.excerpt: The Sensex jumped 1,418.56 points to 78,719.96 and the Nifty rose past 24,300 on November 5, as Brent crude fell close to 10 per cent to around $94 after Democrats swept the US midterms.
articles.nri_angle: Lower crude and a sixth straight session of gains directly affect diaspora investors holding India equity funds and remittance timing as the rupee strengthened to 94.64 per dollar.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Advanced Micro Devices Earnings Beat as Data Center Revenue Nearly Doubles
articles.excerpt: Record revenue of $13.38 billion rose 45% and adjusted EPS jumped 74% to $2.09 as Data Center sales hit $8.55 billion, and AMD guided fourth-quarter revenue to about $17 billion.
articles.image_caption: Advanced Micro Devices headquarters in Santa Clara, California. AMD reported record third-quarter revenue as data center sales nearly doubled.
articles.nri_angle: AMD is a widely held US semiconductor stock, and its AI data-center results move the technology shares many diaspora investors track.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: McDonald's Earnings Beat Estimates Despite Revenue Miss
articles.excerpt: Adjusted EPS rose 11% to $3.57 as franchised margins grew, but revenue of $7.16 billion missed estimates and U.S. comparable sales slipped 0.2%; the dividend rises 4% to $1.93.
articles.image_caption: A McDonald's restaurant. The chain beat third-quarter earnings estimates despite a revenue miss.
articles.nri_angle: McDonald's is one of the most widely held US consumer stocks and a common first employer in diaspora communities; its U.S. sales trend is a read on lower-income consumer spending.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Uber Technologies Q3 Earnings Miss on Investment Loss as Bookings Jump 20%
articles.excerpt: Gross bookings hit $59.82 billion and non-GAAP EPS rose 35% to $0.88, but a $476 million investment revaluation loss cut GAAP earnings to $0.25 per share, below estimates.
articles.image_caption: Uber headquarters in San Francisco. Uber's third-quarter bookings jumped 20 percent, though an investment loss weighed on earnings.
articles.nri_angle: Uber is a daily-use service for diaspora riders and a major gig platform for immigrant drivers and couriers; its bookings and autonomy plans affect both.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Booking Holdings Earnings Beat Estimates as Revenue Misses on FTC Charge
articles.excerpt: Adjusted EPS rose 17% to $4.66 and gross bookings climbed 10% to $54.5 billion, but a $900 million FTC-related revenue reduction pushed reported revenue down 1% and fourth-quarter guidance points to slower growth.
articles.image_caption: Booking Holdings, parent of Booking.com, beat third-quarter earnings estimates as revenue missed on an FTC charge.
articles.nri_angle: Booking Holdings runs Booking.com, Agoda and Priceline, platforms diaspora travellers use heavily for India and international trips; its demand outlook is a read on global travel conditions.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Approves Rs 2,814-Crore Scheme for Lithium, Nickel Processing Plants
articles.excerpt: The Cabinet cleared a 30% capital subsidy for two lithium and two nickel plants over FY 2026-27 to 2030-31, with winners chosen on the lowest support sought and paid in three milestone-linked tranches.
articles.image_caption: An open-pit mining operation and mineral specimens in a WION graphic on India's critical minerals plans. The Union Cabinet has approved a Rs 2,814-crore incentive scheme for domestic lithium and nickel processing plants.

YourStory — Cabinet approves Rs 2,814 Cr scheme to promote processing of lithium, nickel

articles.title: India's Middle Class Borrows Faster Than Incomes as Debt Hits Record
articles.excerpt: Household borrowing surged 36% in a year to a record 46% of GDP, while debt service climbed to about 13% of income and real pay for salaried workers rose less than 4% over three years.
articles.image_caption: Shoppers crowd a market street in Mumbai. Household borrowing in India has risen to a record 46 percent of GDP even as real earnings for salaried workers have barely grown.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora readers with family finances, property and consumer loans in India, a record debt load and expected further RBI rate hikes point to higher repayment costs for households back home.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Democratic Congress Puts AI Spending and Chip Export Controls Under New Scrutiny
articles.excerpt: With Democrats back in control of Congress, analysts expect tighter scrutiny of AI chip exports to China, new cost rules for large data centres, and investigations into the tariff and investment deals of the Trump administration.
articles.image_caption: A Samsung flag and the SK hynix logo at a company building. South Korea’s chipmakers face tighter scrutiny of AI chip exports and US investment pledges after the Democratic midterm victory.
articles.nri_angle: Indian investors holding US AI and chip stocks, and professionals in the Asian semiconductor supply chain, face a new oversight regime in Washington.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Cabinet Clears Rs 14,500 Crore Storage Fund Backing 92 GWh of New Grid Capacity

articles.title: What the Midterms Could Mean for Markets, Debt and AI Stocks

articles.image_caption: Enfield Bullet 350, Kathgodam, India. Royal Enfield sold 1,33,442 motorcycles in October 2026, up 7 per cent from 1,24,951 a year earlier, its highest-ever monthly total in the reports.
articles.image_credit: Photo: Yann ( talk ) via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0)
articles.nri_angle: Record festive demand at Royal Enfield gives diaspora investors in Eicher Motors a concrete read on Indian consumer demand after Diwali-season buying.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Gold Demand Seen At Six-Year Low As Prices Weigh
articles.excerpt: The World Gold Council estimates India's 2026 demand will fall to around 650 metric tons, after September-quarter demand dropped 29% year-on-year to 162.5 tons.
articles.image_caption: Gold crystals are shown in a close-up photograph. The World Gold Council estimates India's 2026 gold demand will fall to about 650 tonnes, the lowest since 2020, as high prices weigh on buying.

sources.label: Reuters - India's 2026 gold demand seen falling to six-year low on price rise
Reuters - WGC lowers outlook for gold investment demand growth as bar buying slows

articles.nri_angle: Gold remains a central store of wealth and wedding purchase for many Indian and diaspora households, so a price-driven fall in India demand signals how high prices are changing buying decisions.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Apple Posts Record India Revenue as Mac and Services Hit Highs
articles.excerpt: Apple's fiscal fourth quarter brought an all-time India revenue record, a September-quarter high for Indian iPhone upgraders, and global revenue of $114.5 billion, up 12 percent year over year.
articles.image_caption: The exterior of an Apple Store, with the company's illuminated logo. Apple reported record revenue in India for its September quarter, with Mac and Services also reaching new highs.
articles.nri_angle: Apple's all-time India revenue record, led by iPhone upgraders, Mac and Services, underlines India's shift from a sales market to a full ecosystem market for the company.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Mukesh Ambani Reclaims Asia's Richest Title as Forbes Puts Wealth at $88.8 Billion
articles.excerpt: An updated Forbes real-time listing credits Ambani with an $8.5 billion Monday gain, moving him past ByteDance co-founder Zhang Yiming ($84 billion) to the top of Asia's rich list at 23rd globally.
articles.image_caption: Mukesh Ambani, chairman and managing director of Reliance Industries, in a portrait photograph. Forbes' real-time billionaire rankings put his net worth at $88.8 billion, returning him to the top of Asia's rich list.
articles.nri_angle: Reliance is one of the most widely held Indian stocks among NRI investors, and Ambani's return to the top of Asia's rich list marks the scale of Monday's rally in their portfolios.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Nasdaq-100 Falls Into Correction as Investors Question AI Spending
articles.excerpt: The tech-heavy index closed 10.4% below its October record in its third correction this year, with chip stocks leading a selloff driven by doubts over AI returns ahead of the midterms.
articles.nri_angle: The correction hits the US tech stocks and index funds widely held by Indian professionals and investors in the United States.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: RBI Eases EDF Filing for Service Exporters With Rs 10 Lakh Route
articles.excerpt: Under the FEMA regulations in force since October 1, service exporters file one monthly EDF, small bills close on self-declaration, and individuals doing personal-nature work were told they do not have to report.
articles.nri_angle: Indian freelancers and firms billing overseas clients — including clients in the US — now declare service exports under one monthly EDF, with a per-bill Rs 10 lakh self-declaration route.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: FIIs Turn Selective Buyers: Stake Hikes in 27 Stocks After Two Quarters of Heavy Selling
articles.excerpt: Foreign investors bought a net Rs 13,970 crore in the September quarter after selling over Rs 2.7 lakh crore in the prior two, and filings show four straight quarters of stake hikes in names from BHEL to Groww.
articles.nri_angle: NRI portfolios track FII flows as a sentiment gauge for Indian equities; the four-quarter accumulation list names the stocks foreign funds keep choosing.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Ambani Adds $6.3 Billion in a Day as Reliance Shares Jump 11.6% on Record Quarterly Profit
articles.excerpt: Reliance's best trading session in over six years, driven by a 40.6% rise in September-quarter profit, made Mukesh Ambani the world's biggest gainer on Forbes' real-time rich list and kept him India's richest person.
articles.image_caption: Mukesh Ambani speaks at a public event. Reliance Industries shares rose 11.6% on Monday after the company's September-quarter profit rose 40.6% from a year earlier.
articles.nri_angle: Reliance is among the most widely held Indian stocks among NRI investors, and its quarter sets the tone for India's earnings season.
